english.title: Employer fail to ensure information on emergency arrangements available re asbestos related incident

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: use of asbestos in a work process

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer, failed to ensure that information on emergency arrangements was available in order to protect the health of your employees from an accident, incident or emergency, related to the

(A)_[use of asbestos in a work process,]_
(B)_[removal of asbestos-containing materials,]_
(C)_[repair of asbestos-containing materials,]_

at a workplace, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WORKPLACE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 15(3)(b) of the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 and section 33(1)(c) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work Act etc 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) These Regulations apply to any work outside Great Britain to which sections 1 to 59 and 80 to 82 of the Health and Safety at Work Act etc 1974 Act apply by virtue of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974 (Application Outside Great Britain) Order 2001 as they apply to work in Great Britain.
(ii) Regulation 15(5) states that Regulation 15(3) does not apply where (a) the results of the risk assessment show that, because of the quantity of asbestos present at the workplace, there is only a slight risk to the health of employees; and (b) the measures taken by the employer to comply with the duty under regulation 11(1) are sufficient to control that risk.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Note: In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (general limit on magistrates' court's powers to imprison), a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months is to be read as a reference to imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months.
